items.name: dsh-review

items.name: dsh-user-experience

items.name: dsh-session-review

items.name: dsh-diff-viewer

items.name: dsh-git-identity

items.name: dsh-change-review

items.name: dsh-explorer#dsh-explorer
items.desc: Git-first file-tree sidebar for the DSH web GUI: VS Code-style indent guides, M/A/U/D/R git decorations, HEAD-vs-worktree diff preview, media preview, and drag-to-reference (files/folders/selected code with line numbers) — pure plugin.

items.name: dsh-github-login
items.desc: Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.

items.name: dsh-atomgit
items.desc: AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: six built-in AtomGit skills (plan issues, implement issues, review PRs, merge PRs, publish CLI releases, mirror to GitHub) plus ag CLI integration and platform-hosted MCP tools for repos, branches, issues, PRs, and search.

items.name: dsh-github-intelligence
items.desc: The most complete GitHub integration for dsh: repo overview, releases, issues, pull requests, contributors, search, and a deep repo report with TTL caching — no API key needed.

items.name: dsh-web-ui#dsh-git-graph

items.name: dsh-revdiff

items.name: dsh-gitflow
items.desc: Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.

items.name: dsh-git-hygiene
items.desc: Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).

items.name: dsh-vscode-review#dsh-review
items.desc: Records every agent write, edit and shell `rm` into a shadow git repository, then reviews them hunk by hunk in VS Code — accept or revert each one. Needs the companion dsh-review-vscode extension; the panel only appears inside VS Code's webview.

items.name: dsh-git-graph
items.desc: Read-only Git Graph in the native DSH Web sidebar, with commit history, branch and tag refs, file diffs, two-commit comparison, and full historical source.

items.name: dsh-review-loop
items.desc: Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.

items.name: dsh-github-release-radar
items.desc: Track releases and stars of any public GitHub repository from inside dsh agents — no API key needed.

items.name: pr-genius
items.desc: PR evaluation and improvement consultant: assesses PR success probability based on historical anti-patterns and success patterns, with one-click scoring and actionable suggestions.

items.name: dsh-skill-7d-git-commit
items.desc: Checks git commit messages against the 7DGroup convention (Chinese type tags, length and punctuation rules) before committing, as a client-side guard before GitLab pre-receive hooks.

items.name: worktree-mgr
items.desc: Per-task isolated git worktrees with a full create/sync/finish lifecycle: task names auto-derive branches, merge targets are double-checked, and batch cleanup is built in — zero manual git operations.

items.name: dsh-git-worktree
items.desc: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.

items.name: dsh-code-smell
items.desc: Code smell radar: statically scans TODO/FIXME debt, stub implementations, long lines, oversized files and duplicated blocks, with severity-sorted read-only fix suggestions.

items.name: dsh-workspace-snapshot
items.desc: Reports bounded, repository-relative Git status as structured data without staging, committing, or changing branches.

items.name: dsh-git-workflow
items.desc: Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.

items.name: dsh-git-nexus
items.desc: Git and GitHub panel for the DSH web profile: stage/unstage/discard/diff, branches, commit, push/pull/sync, log, file browser, workflow board, and GitHub OAuth with PR creation.

items.name: dsh-ocr-review
items.desc: Local AI code-review gate: review a workspace/branch/commit diff via the managed ocr.js, returning structured findings with token stats; gate mode fails on findings.

items.name: adversarial-review
items.desc: Adversarial multi-lens code review: parallel correctness/security/maintainability lenses attack a diff, with deterministic severity grading, suppression rules and incremental review history.

items.name: dsh-ci-context
items.desc: Injects allowlisted GitHub Actions and GitLab CI run metadata into agent context without reading logs, credentials, or provider APIs.

items.name: dsh-tool-github
items.desc: GitHub REST API tools + browser sidebar panel: repos, search, issues, PRs, comments, account binding (credential-store), and one-click clone-as-workspace.

items.name: dsh-diff-approval
items.desc: Pending-change review for DeepSeek Harness: every `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` change is collected automatically into the file list, where a single change block, the blocks within a selection, or the whole file can be kept or reverted, and undo/redo is supported. It imports the workspace's version-control changes, shows the diff in a single-column or side-by-side view, and provides a Markdown preview in which changes can also be kept or reverted, in-file search, block jumping and copyable line references; the diff data is stored persistently, so the review continues after a restart.

items.name: harness-github
items.desc: DSH GitHub connector: review PRs, triage issues, debug CI, prepare changes (18 tools, gh-first + REST fallback, approval-gated writes).

items.name: dsh-git-panel
items.desc: Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-git-graph
items.desc: Right-sidebar page for DSH that draws the current session's repository as a VS Code-style commit graph - colored branch/merge lanes, ref chips and per-commit details - with a working-tree Changes area above it (staged/unstaged sections with inline diffs) for every working tree of the repository; read-only, works with or without dsh-better-sidebar, and follows the session's worktree label when dsh-session-worktree is installed.

items.name: codex-guard#dsh
items.desc: Pre-submit pull-request hygiene checks inside DeepSeek Harness: scans the current diff for TODO leftovers, hardcoded secrets, and non-conventional commit subjects.

items.name: dsh-gitmate
items.desc: Git panel in the right sidebar plus fifteen agent tools: editor-style diffs, a commit graph across every branch, staging and committing, branch, stash and remote operations, and model-assisted commit messages, pre-commit review and commit splitting.

items.name: dsh-worktree
items.desc: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.

items.name: dsh-github
items.desc: GitHub account management plus a local Git workflow for the web GUI with clone, fast-forward pull, status, commit, push, and host-side push guards.

items.name: dsh-github-router
items.desc: Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.

items.name: dsh-review
items.desc: A code review workflow that reviews uncommitted changes, changes against a base branch, a single commit, a GitHub pull request, or a file.

items.name: dsh-open-code-review
items.desc: Review code with Open Code Review: deterministic scope and rule resolution, judged by your own DSH model, no API key.

items.name: dsh-fork-worktree
items.desc: Fork and delete buttons on each workspace row of the Harness sidebar, plus a /fork-worktree command: fork creates a git worktree and registers it as a new workspace, delete removes the workspace folder through git worktree remove (asking again before discarding uncommitted work) and drops the registration.

items.name: dsh-review-checkout
items.desc: Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs that never wrap, real line numbers, open-at-line and a draggable split, a hover preview of the whole file with three lines of context around each change, one-click per-turn revert, and the on-disk record size with a clear button in the review toolbar. Records are sharded per session, with content-addressed snapshot blobs that dedupe and are garbage collected. Light/dark presets follow the DSH theme, typography follows DSH and installed skins (or any font on the machine, with a px stepper), and a settings switch injects a think-in-Simplified-Chinese rule into the global AGENTS.md.

items.name: dsh-git-plus
items.desc: Sidebar Git panel for the DSH web GUI: Local Changes and All Commits views, branch, tag and stash management with fetch, pull and push dialogs, merge with conflict handling, and a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar.

items.name: dsh-zcode-git
items.desc: Structured git tools for DeepSeek Harness agents: status, diff, log, branch, commit and stash. Output is pinned with ten `git -c` overrides so a user pager, colour or quotepath setting cannot reshape what the agent reads; every invocation is an argv array, so no shell ever parses an argument; and the mutating actions go through the harness approval service, refusing rather than proceeding when no approval service is mounted.

items.name: clutch-dsh#clutch-dsh-worktree
items.desc: Adds a Worktree view to DSH Web UI that groups Sessions by Git worktree while keeping DSH as the source of truth.

items.name: dsh-plugin-git
items.desc: Git service plus right-sidebar UI — a Changes tab (stage/unstage, per-file diffs, commit/amend, push and rebase-then-push sync, confirmed discard), a paged canvas commit-graph tab, a Worktrees tab to list, enter and create checkouts, a composer branch selector, and opt-in LLM commit-message generation.

items.name: dsh-cool-git
items.desc: Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.

items.name: dsh-git-manager
items.desc: A GitHub-connected visual git manager for DeepSeek Harness: guided GitHub-Flow steps, commit graph with PR/CI badges, one-click GitHub login, PR and issue management, and structured git tools for the agent. Renamed from gitcompass in 2.0.0.

items.name: dsh-wending-git-workbench
items.desc: Codex-style Git workbench: workspace-scoped changes, diff, stage, commit, guarded branch operations, graph history, fetch, fast-forward pull, and upstream push through official plugin APIs.

items.name: dsh-pr-board
items.desc: Maintainer and developer PR board for the DSH sidebar: a five-state review queue (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), a three-column issue board, and a global view of the PRs you authored (my move / waiting on others / merged), with CI rollup badges, an inactivity filter, and one click per card to open or start the matching review conversation.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-git
items.desc: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via fs.watch plus a changeToken poll.

items.name: dsh-changelog-zh
items.desc: Turns real git history into two Chinese changelog drafts (short for users, long for developers); every entry carries its commit SHA and an evidence-backed verified/unverified mark, and commit subjects are never translated.

items.name: dsh-git-push
items.desc: Git commit-and-push automation for DSH with pre-push auditing, rule-based quality scoring, SSH key generation, and a three-tab settings sidebar.

items.name: dsh-git-graph
items.desc: Git view for DeepSeek Harness: status, commit graph, branches and tags in one picker, diff, staging/commit, push/pull and blame.

items.name: dsh-code-review
items.desc: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.

items.name: dsh-vcs
items.desc: Read-only Git and SVN change review inside DeepSeek Harness, with repository browsing and side-by-side diffs.

items.name: agentsgitflowcontroller
items.desc: Branch-role guard for AI coding agents: configurable integration/preview/production/archive roles, blocking direct push, force-push and delete on protected branches and agent merges into production/archive.

items.name: dsh-git-panel
items.desc: The session page has an extra "Git" page; on the left is a preview of the non-staged/staged changes, and on the right is a diff preview with a row-level action bar (staged/discarded).

items.name: dsh-github-push
items.desc: One-step GitHub uploader: initializes git, auto-creates or improves README, sets repository topics, and pushes a local project to GitHub.

items.name: dsh-git-branch
items.desc: Branch and worktree management for DeepSeek Harness: the workspace toolbar shows the current branch with in-place switching, plus an IDEA-style branch selector, remote branch checkout, context menus (create, rename, delete, copy), push and update, and branch isolation into standalone worktrees with managed creation and deletion.

items.name: dsh-simple-worktree-plus
items.desc: Manages Git worktrees in DeepSeek Harness with branch deletion controls and scoped workspace management.

items.name: dsh-gitea
items.desc: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.

items.name: dsh-git-sidebar
items.desc: VSCode-style uncommitted-changes sidebar docked to the right of the DSH web conversation page: staged / unstaged / untracked file groups, status badges, per-file +/− line counts, click-to-expand diff, rename as old → new, untracked content preview, and open with the system default application.

items.name: dsh-blast-radius

items.name: dsh-git-review
items.desc: Review tab for DeepSeek Harness sessions: workspace changes versus HEAD or any two refs as a filterable file tree with side-by-side diffs, a lane commit graph with blame and file history, three-scope search, line comments back to the composer, and guarded stage/commit/branch/tag/stash/conflict operations.

items.name: dsh-plugin-git
items.desc: Git workbench in the DSH session header and overlay: view changes, commit, fetch, pull, push, and browse branches and history in existing local repositories.

items.name: dsh-pr-guardian
items.desc: Authored pull request feedback inbox with paginated GitHub collection, priority favorites, and version-bound local progress shared by the DSH panel and CLI.

items.name: dsh-tool-radar
items.desc: Score a GitHub repo's contribution-friendliness from live merge and maintainer evidence.

items.name: dsh-worktree-panel
items.desc: Git worktree panel for DSH Web: replaces the workspace sidebar with project → main/linked worktree → session groups, creates and removes worktrees, switches the main branch, and migrates configurable project-local or global storage with dirty-tree and active-session safeguards.

items.name: dsh-gitee-chat
items.desc: Gitee Enterprise project management inside the conversation: issues, pull requests, kanban and the Gitee MCP toolchain.

items.name: dsh-git-flow
items.desc: Branch chip in the composer tool row that switches, creates, and refreshes workspace branches, commits a checked subset of changed files with a message the session's own model writes from the diff, and pushes the current branch.

items.name: deepseek-harness-desktop-ultra#dsh-plugin-repopanel
items.desc: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard for an agent to claim.

items.name: dsh-github-flow
items.desc: Wraps the local GitHub CLI (gh) in agent tools for pull requests, issues, Actions runs, repository search and raw API calls, plus /gh status and /gh help slash commands and two web panels (a global repository cockpit and a per-session workspace panel).

items.name: dsh-command-code-review
items.desc: Registers a /code-review slash command with five parallel review lenses and per-finding confidence scoring, for both pull requests and local code.

items.name: dsh-git-workbench
items.desc: Git development workbench for DeepSeek Harness: captures branch, status, worktrees, stashes and recent commits, with commands, tools and a settings UI.

Finishing a task can merge the work back into each repository's target branch, remove the worktrees, and file whatever Git does not track in an archive directory you choose.

items.name: dsh-ide-git
items.desc: JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.

items.name: dsh-workspace-git-badge#dsh-git-badge
items.desc: Git status badges for DSH: sidebar workspace-row badges and an input-row chip showing the current conversation's workspace git state, with event-driven freshness over SSE.

items.name: dsh-dev-git-graph#dsh-dev-git-graph
items.desc: A Git Graph tab for DSH Web: a faithful port of vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 that registers a native tab in the dsh-better-sidebar right rail (prerequisite), auto-binds to the session workspace, runs the full git operations (checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash) directly on the host, and opens file diffs in the built-in DiffTab.

items.name: dsh_vscodemode
items.desc: VSCode-style editing experience for DeepSeek Harness: a Monaco-based central file editor (tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, status bar) and interactive diff review of agent edit/write results with per-change Keep/Undo, rollback and archiving, persisted across restarts.

items.name: dsh-task-worktree

items.name: dsh-codex-parity
items.desc: Codex-style Git panel for DeepSeek Harness: a header button opens a menu with commit, push, branch switching and creation, and repository initialization; shows the current branch and the total additions and deletions of uncommitted files.

items.name: dsh-git

The token stays in the host half through ctx.credentials and /dsh-git/* accepts loopback requests only.

items.name: dsh-plugin-github
items.desc: Agent-facing GitHub repository tools: binds an account through a first-run prompt, then clones into the workspace and reads, exact-replaces, commits and pushes files, with writes off by default.

items.name: dsh-git-composer
items.desc: Claude-style Git branch and PR composer bar for DeepSeek Harness: quick branch switcher, native diff drawer integration, and adaptive PR creation with Actions CI status.

items.name: dsh-review-squad
items.desc: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one severity-grouped report from /review or a code_review tool call.

items.name: dsh-ma-plugins#dsh-librarian
items.desc: Evidence-first GitHub research subagent with bounded tools and in-memory request caching.

items.name: dsh-git-plus
items.desc: DSH Source Control tab in dsh-better-sidebar that mirrors VS Code Git workflows.

items.name: dsh-forge

Tool metadata is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.

items.name: dsh-git-idea
items.desc: Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count, opens a branch switcher on hover and an IDEA-style VCS panel on click (branch tree, commit graph, changes and staging, commit detail, file diff), plus a settings page for commit identity, the git binary and the network flags. Registers no model tools with DSH.

items.name: dsh-backstory
items.desc: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.

items.name: dsh-git-change
items.desc: Git status badge in the composer tool row: a 14px branch glyph left of the model selector, with branch name, changed-file count and +added/-deleted lines on hover. Counts staged, unstaged and untracked files; nothing renders outside a git work tree.

items.name: dsh-github-workbench
items.desc: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.

items.name: dsh-code-review

items.name: dsh-open-code-review
items.desc: Alibaba Open Code Review for DSH: host-model delegation with native preview/rule tools and a review skill, plus optional OCR-managed reviews.

items.name: dsh-github-connect
items.desc: Connects your GitHub account to DSH agents from the composer GitHub button (OAuth device flow or personal access token) and lets them call the GitHub API through the github_api tool.

items.name: dsh-git-manager

items.name: gitnexus-plus

items.name: gord-dsh-worktree
items.desc: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness — isolate parallel work in its own directory and branch. Ships Fast mode (快速模式).

items.name: dsh-git-forge

Pushes to a host the project has not granted are rejected.

items.name: dsh-worktree-studio
items.desc: Human-operated Git worktree task board for DeepSeek Harness with validation-bound merge delivery.

items.name: dsh-git-statusline
items.desc: Compact Git status line for DSH Web: the current branch, staged and unstaged line changes, ahead/behind commit counts against upstream, and a clean-worktree marker — placeable in the sidebar footer, the session header, or above/below the composer, with the position switched on the settings page.

items.name: dsh-git-commit
items.desc: DSH slash command /commit: stages all changes, summarizes the staged diff with the session model, and commits; no browser UI required, with a local fallback when the model call fails.

items.name: dsh-web-git-sidebar
items.desc: Source Control panel in the DSH Web left rail: search, switch and create branches with ahead/behind counts, a topo-order commit graph, and a click-to-expand preview of any commit showing its files (A/M/D), insertions and deletions, message, author and timestamp. An always-on footer dock above Settings carries the branch dropdown and recent commits and follows the open session; fetch and fast-forward pull are one button, and a git_worktree agent tool creates, lists and removes worktrees.

items.name: dsh-git-plugins#bundle
items.desc: Git and source-control plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness: local git operations plus GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea adapters, with self-evolving memory.

items.name: dsh-worktree-manager
items.desc: Git worktree management for dsh — group workspaces by repository, create and switch worktrees, and browse their changes, commit history and file diffs.

items.name: dsh-git-view
items.desc: Git tab in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view: reviews every repository in the session working directory and commits each on its own, with change groups, whole-file / changes-only / side-by-side diffs, in-panel editing, and a push button that lists every commit it would publish.

items.name: dsh-git-tools
items.desc: Four dependency-free local git tools (status, diff, log, commit) for DeepSeek Harness operating on the session workspace.

items.name: dsh-review
items.desc: Snapshot-bound multi-agent Git review with independent verification, majority voting, resolution tracking and an AI review gate.

items.name: dsh-git-connector
items.desc: Git repository connector for DeepSeek Harness: saved repo profiles addressed by name, work-copy operations (clone/fetch/pull/push/commit), Gitea/Forgejo/GitHub API tools, keys in the DSH credential center, and per-repo safety flags (TLS bypass, overwrite, force push).

items.name: dsh-ci-co-pilot
items.desc: GitHub CI co-pilot for DeepSeek Harness: PR review, CI failure fixing, issue triage and release notes.

items.name: dsh-git-vcs
items.desc: A right-sidebar Git panel in the IDEA style — local changes with per-file checkbox commits, a commit tree with per-commit details, branch, remote and stash management, push with a credential fallback, all driven by the plain git CLI.

items.name: dsh-github-companion

items.name: dsh-codex-review

items.name: dsh-llm-verifier

items.name: dsh-git-server
items.desc: Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki — reusing user-management credentials, start/stop from the settings page.

items.name: dsh-github-sync
items.desc: Bidirectional GitHub repository sync for DSH: git sync with conflict rollback and pre-push checks, Actions/CI monitoring with per-step run detail, repository add/remove/rename, a web panel with local and remote file browsers, scheduled automation, and six agent tools.

items.name: dsh-git-panel
items.desc: IDE-style Git panel in the DSH Web GUI: a resident tab with a three-column overview (branch/tag list, searchable commit-history graph, commit detail with changed-file tree and message) and a changes page (stats bar, uncommitted list with per-file stage/unstage/discard, commit box with amend); side-by-side diffs carry lazy highlight.js syntax highlighting, on-demand between-hunk context expansion and word-level intra-line emphasis, with image files shown as before/after panes; plus a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar. Every git command runs as an argv array through the host subprocess service, cwd locked to the repo root.

items.name: dsh-solution-explorer
items.desc: DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push sync, branch and remote management, git init, multi-repo switch, color-coded file status, file-type icons), an editor view that opens every file reached from the chat, the file tree or source control (Markdown/HTML/PDF/image previews, 15-language syntax highlighting, hunk-level diff editing, Ctrl+S save), file operations (new/move/copy/delete, reveal in file explorer), a collapsible icon rail, a multi-tab bottom terminal (ConPTY), and commit messages generated from the staged diff by a host-configured model.

items.name: dsh-source-control
items.desc: VSCode-style Source Control page in the DSH Web right sidebar: a paged commit lane graph with ref markers and per-commit diffs, grouped working-tree changes with stage/discard/unstage, a commit box with amend and AI-generated messages, a side-by-side and unified diff page, GitHub repository and pull request creation through the gh CLI, and bidirectional HTTPS/SSH remote switching.

items.name: dsh-knj-version-control
items.desc: Version-control workbench for the DSH Web sidebar: local changes grouped by type, per-file and multi-file staging, preview-confirmed commit / update / push, and a failure dialog that shows the raw Git output instead of a four-second toast.

items.name: dsh-import-repositories
items.desc: Runs git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work inside the agent sandbox; exposes 8 agent tools (status, diff, log, stage, commit, push, fetch, pull) and 11 slash commands including /git-status, /git-commit, /git-tag and /git-name-set.

items.name: dsh-code-review
items.desc: One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.

items.name: dsh-plugin-git-workbench
items.desc: Local Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: branch search and switching, hunk-level staging, commit graph, file history and blame, stash and worktree management, conflict resolution, and eight git tools for the agent.

items.name: dsh-tauri-turnrewind
items.desc: Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files changed after the turn are refused with a conflict diff unless --force or --skip-conflicts is passed, and HEAD, index, stash and commit history of the user repository are never written.

items.name: dsh-turnsnap
items.desc: Zero-config per-turn git checkpoints: after every completed agent turn in a git workspace, stages all changes into one tagged \[turnsnap] commit (serialized queue, sandbox-policy aware), so any turn is a rollback point.

items.name: dsh-review
items.desc: Runs a diff past several reviewers at once — a CLI coding agent such as codex or claude, or a DSH subagent — and merges their separate sections into one report; reviewers and named review modes are configured in the settings UI.

items.name: dsh-svn-tools
items.desc: SVN (Subversion) toolset for DeepSeek Harness: 33 agent tools (status, diff, log, blame, commit, merge, props, lock, changelist...) plus a sidebar panel with side-by-side BASE/working-copy diff, conflict resolution and AI commit logs.

items.name: dsh-auto-git
items.desc: Runs git init in each newly registered DSH workspace, with an empty initial commit by default, so git-aware plugins have a repository to attach to; directories already inside a work tree are skipped.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-git-graph
items.desc: Git branch selector and Git graph for the dsh web GUI: switch branches and explore branch-lane and commit history from the conversation header.

items.name: dsh-update
items.desc: One-click update for the local DeepSeek Harness checkout — compare versions, pull and rebuild, then restart, and roll back to any past release, all from a sidebar panel with live progress.

items.name: source-code-mgmt
items.desc: Code management panel for the DSH web UI that handles everyday Git in five steps: ① env check auto-detects git/gh/ssh and one-click installs missing tools (gh mirror download sources speed up installs, Windows included) with check-update; ② SSH ed25519 key generation / connection tests plus one-click 443 config to bypass blocked port 22, with the Gitee personal token configured here; ③ repo status, side-by-side diffs, stage/commit, branch switching, history with revert/cherry-pick, one-click repo creation and push, auto-ignoring >100MB files; ④ lists all repos of your account for one-click clone; ⑤ five-step npm publish wizard. GitHub / Gitee dual-platform, with the UI switching between 中文 and English live.

items.name: dsh-github-mcp
items.desc: Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server as a DSH plugin: stores the PAT in DSH's credential center (.credentials.yaml) via github_set_token, and exposes GitHub tools as mcp__github__*.

items.name: dsh-github-mcp-hint
items.desc: GitHub MCP helper panel: shows copyable example prompts at Settings → Plugins → GitHub MCP (random 4 from a 30-example pool), visualizes a public user's repo star/fork/language, and adds the gh_repo_stats and gh_current_user model tools.
